title: Measuring, Localizing, and Ablating Alignment Signatures in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.30526v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aligned language models often exhibit a recognizable AI-like style, yet its connection to post-training and internal representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we study whether post-training introduces or amplifies AI-like stylistic regularities and whether these regularities have a localized internal signature. To this end, we compare human text, base-model generations, and aligned-model generations under matched human-source prefixes. Aligned generations show lower human-corpus affinity and higher AI-detection rates than base generations, suggesting that post-training shifts generated text away from human-corpus style and toward detector-visible AI-like text. We then introduce PASTA (Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation), a training-free method that estimates a post-training alignment signature from aligned-base residual contrasts and ablates the corresponding direction during decoding. translated_title: 《测量、定位与消融大语言模型中的对齐签名》
translated_abstract: 经过对齐的大语言模型通常表现出一种可被识别的类AI风格，但这种风格与后训练及模型内部表征之间的联系仍知之甚少。在本工作中，我们研究了后训练是否引入或放大了类AI的风格规律性，以及这些规律性是否对应于一个可局部化的内部签名。为此，我们在匹配的人类来源前缀条件下，比较了人类文本、基座模型生成文本与对齐模型生成文本。结果表明，与基座模型的生成文本相比，对齐模型的生成文本具有更低的人类语料亲和度和更高的AI检测率，这说明后训练使生成文本偏离了人类语料风格，转向了检测器易于识别的类AI文本。随后，我们提出了PASTA（Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation，后训练对齐签名定向消融），这是一种无需训练的方法：它通过对比对齐模型与基座模型的残差来估计后训练对齐签名，并在解码过程中消融相应的方向。在11个……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现后训练会使大语言模型的生成文本偏离人类语料风格并呈现出可被AI检测器识别的类AI特征，并提出了无需训练的PASTA方法，通过从残差对比中估计对齐签名方向并在解码时消融该方向，从而定位并去除模型内部的这一AI风格签名。
